Ben / Samir —

Quick technical summary:
- Root cause: transient interconnect flaps in our us-west peering that caused route reconvergence for a subset of customer-facing frontends.
- Impact window matches Samir’s timestamps. Packet loss and higher Tail P99 latency were observed for ~12–15 minutes in both incidents.
- Mitigation we’re implementing: (1) increase route redundancy between peering endpoints for LobX-specific clusters, (2) pin a secondary route with lower BGP flap sensitivity for production customers, and (3) add an automated route-failover health check to trigger client-side routing fallback sooner.

Proposed short-term commercial gesture (pending leadership sign-off): one free month of service credit OR a one-time invoice credit equal to 20% of Sep invoice (capped). We’ll include the exact cap in the ask to Exec (Ben/Marissa).

I’ve attached the raw route timeline (route-fallover-timeline.csv) for your SOC/compliance review.

— Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
